entrada.texto:
Algorithm. PoAh smart contract.
Resource utilization
An operational testbed for real-world circumstances and a simulated setting for large-scale research have been 
used to evaluate the developed PoAh consensus method. This Section presents the specifics of both possibilities, 
particularly the experiment design used to confirm the sustainability of the suggested model and the analysis of 
the findings. The PoAh algorithm implements a less resource and energy-intensive authentication approach. It 
is beneficial for resource-constrained IIoT designs. An overview of the critical features of the PoAh consensus 
algorithm is provided below. For simulation setting we have considered 6 computing nodes among these five 
nodes are developed to collect data using IoT devices. In our experimentation, we attempted to conduct PoW 
and PoS on the actual resource-constrained IoT devices; it should be mentioned. We saw that these demanding 
algorithms could not finish even one mining run. We noticed that even after running the testbed software 
foundation for days, it still needed to be completed. These powerful consensus methods cannot be implemented 
on IoT devices with limited resources. Assuming that these IoT devices are battery-operated and placed in 
potentially remote areas for real-world applications, such as smart cities, it is evident that more than the battery 
will be required to conduct even one mining operation for these demanding algorithms.
Execution time
Compared to standard PoW , PoAh offers a key advantage of reduced execution time without compromising on 
security. PoW , which takes about 10 min to validate a single block, is simply not practical for IoT use. In response 
to this challenge, PoAh employs cryptographic authentication for block validation, a process that is rapid and 
significantly reduces execution time. This makes PoAh a highly suitable option for IIoT networks with limited 
resources. The execution time is the total time needed to complete one transaction request authentication, which 
is defined as follows:
 ∂T txr = Tch − Ti
Here Tchrepresents the specific node timestamp which is added to the blockchain network. Ti is the initial 
timestamp of node transactions request. The proposed authentication consensus mechanism provides better 
execution time, which is suitable for IoT applications.
Security
Integrating PoAh as a consensus algorithm into blockchain-based IoT frameworks ensures an IoT framework’s 
sustained security, providing real-time security and accurate data authentication. The security needed for 
cryptocurrency is different from that required for IoT systems. PoAh, apart from the reverse hash calculation

resposta.resumo: O artigo apresenta o algoritmo PoAh, um consenso leve que reduz o consumo de recursos e o tempo de execução em comparação ao PoW e PoS, tornando‑se adequado para dispositivos IIoT de baixa potência em cenários de cidades inteligentes. Testes em bancada com seis nós demonstram que PoAh valida blocos rapidamente, mantendo a segurança ao integrar a criptografia do PoW.

resposta.interpretacao: O estudo demonstra que o consenso PoAh pode superar as limitações de energia e tempo dos algoritmos tradicionais, oferecendo uma solução viável para a integração de blockchain em dispositivos IIoT de baixa potência, especialmente em ambientes de cidades inteligentes onde a conectividade pode ser limitada.
